scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Do you want to
sing a song with me?
Sha la la la la~
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
要和我一起唱首歌吗？
沙啦啦啦啦~

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
The dreary world
of mortals is in need
of more cheerful song.
Will you bring it to them
and turn the tide in the
battle against evil?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
凡人沉闷的世界
需要更多欢快的歌声。
你愿意为他们带来歌声，
扭转对抗邪恶的战局吗？

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Will you do this
for Midgard...
As a Minstrel?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
你愿意为了米德加尔特……
以宫廷乐师的身份这么做吗？

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
等你准备好了，
随时可以回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回到我这里之前，用完所有剩余的技能点。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Congratulations!
As a Minstrel, your
your songs will bring
hope to your allies, and
desperation to your foes.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
恭喜！
身为宫廷乐师，
你的歌声将为盟友带来希望，
让敌人陷入绝望。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
欢迎来到
瓦尔哈拉，
荣耀之殿。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
请在此
随意放松。
向勇士们致敬！
